sentences.text:
1 2. By this application the petitioner, namely, Sri Papu Das @ Pappu Das has prayed for pre arrest bail under section 482 of the BNSS, 2023 who is apprehending arrest in connection with Garchuk PS Case No.276/2024 (GR Case No.5184/2024) under sections 420/406 IPC.
3.
The case diary called for is received and the same is perused.

4. The materials so far collected by the investigating authority, in the considered opinion of this court do not warrant custodial interrogation of the present petitioner subject to the condition that the petitioner will appear before the investigating officer, record his statement and cooperate with the investigation and do not repeat such kind of offence.

5. As such this anticipatory bail application is hereby disposed of by providing that in the event of arrest of the petitioner in connection with the aforementioned case, the petitioner, above named shall be released on bail on furnishing a bond of Rs.30,000/- with one local surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the arresting authority subject to the condition that:
I. The petitioner shall appear before the Officer in charge of the concerned PS within 10 (ten) days from today; II.

The petitioner shall not directly or indirectly, make any inducement, threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him/her from disclosing such facts to the Court or to any police officer.

III. The petitioner shall not leave the territorial jurisdiction of the concerned I.O.
without prior intimation Page No.# 3/3 and shall not hamper with the investigation or tamper with the evidence of the case.
IV. The petitioner shall not repeat such kind of offence in the future.
6. The pre-arrest bail application stands disposed off.
